description: This file defines a database migration class for version 4.3.3 of the OrangeHRM software. It manages schema changes such as altering column types, removing conflicting foreign keys, and updating table structures within the migration process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class responsible for managing database schema updates and foreign key conflicts during the installation or upgrade process of OrangeHRM version 4.3.3.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration steps which include removing conflicting foreign keys, altering columns, and recreating foreign key constraints.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number of this migration, i.e., '4.3.3'.

methods.name: getConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Detects foreign key constraints that conflict with the migration, particularly those involving specific tables.

methods.name: removeConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Removes identified foreign key constraints that conflict with the migration process.

methods.name: recreateRemovedForeignKeys
methods.description: Recreates foreign key constraints that were removed during conflict resolution.
